subject.title: scripts/pr prepare gates: local 88-shard pnpm test is un-passable on a busy maintainer Mac (watchdog kills, heavy-check lock contention)

question: Should `scripts/pr prepare-gates` use the existing `OPENCLAW_TESTBOX=1` hosted exact-head verifier, a new Crabbox remote `pnpm test` lane, or a whole-block local lock as the sanctioned maintainer landing path?
rationale: This changes release-gate evidence and maintainer landing workflow semantics, and the repository already has overlapping hosted-gate and remote-check mechanisms that need one owner-approved policy.

options.title: Harden existing Testbox gate
options.body: Document and, if needed, extend `OPENCLAW_TESTBOX=1` as the sanctioned remote gate while adding whole-block serialization for local fallback runs.

options.title: Add explicit remote test mode
options.body: Introduce a dedicated remote `pnpm test` prepare-gate mode with timing/lease evidence when hosted exact-head CI is not sufficient.

options.title: Keep local default only
options.body: Leave the gate local by default and rely on manual worker throttling, accepting that busy maintainer Macs can still block landings.

recommendation.title: Harden existing Testbox gate
recommendation.body: Document and, if needed, extend `OPENCLAW_TESTBOX=1` as the sanctioned remote gate while adding whole-block serialization for local fallback runs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to hosted release-control and changed-check gate behavior, which is the central policy seam.
